# AJ: Webflow & Astro Developer

> AJ is a Webflow Developer with 3+ years of professional agency experience and 40+ websites worked on for agencies and international businesses. AJ builds polished, production-ready websites in Webflow, Framer and Astro, and migrates sites from Webflow, Framer, WordPress and Wix to Astro + Sanity.

## Pages
- [Home](https://angelicojohn.github.io/angelico-portfolio/): Services, AI-assisted development, selected work and experience.
- [Astro Development & Migrations](https://angelicojohn.github.io/angelico-portfolio/astro/): Migrating from Webflow, Framer, WordPress and Wix to Astro + Sanity; platform comparison; web app features and automations; SEO and AEO setup; process and FAQ.
- [Projects](https://angelicojohn.github.io/angelico-portfolio/projects/): Production Webflow and Framer websites.

## Services
- Figma → Webflow builds, CMS architecture, custom code, motion and interactions
- Astro development and migrations, with Sanity as the content editor
- Web app features (portals, booking, payments, calculators) and automations (CRM, notifications, n8n/Zapier/Make)
- Technical SEO and Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO)
